parameters.jsCode: const row = $input.first()?.json; if (!row?.payload) throw new Error('Maintenance snapshot unavailable'); const snapshot = JSON.parse(row.payload); if (snapshot.schemaVersion !== 1) throw new Error('Unexpected snapshot version'); return [{ json: snapshot }];
